description: This source file defines data structures and parsing logic for deep links related to agent and gateway connections in the OpenClawKit application. It includes enums, structs, and functions to create, parse, and handle deep link URLs, facilitating navigation and configuration within the app.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code to create a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL with the 'openclaw' scheme to determine if it is an agent or gateway deep link and returns the corresponding DeepLinkRoute.
